recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros inspired by Breaking Bad
ingredients: 1 tbsp Chipotle Adobo Sauce (from can) and a few of the sauce
14 ounce can Fire Roasted Crushed Tomatoes
instructions: For the Tortillas

Measure masa harina and whisk together with Kosher salt, then add warm tap water and mix until a playdough-like ball forms. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. - 9 ½ ounces Masa Harina - 2 tsp Kosher Salt - 1 cup Water - 2 tbsp Water
Once that’s done, form dough into golf sized balls and place in tortilla press, which you can line with a cut open Ziploc bag to easily remove tortillas.

Place tortilla on cast iron skillet that has been preheated for 10 minutes on medium high heat. Cook for 30 seconds on each side until lightly browned. Stack and cover with a kitchen towel to keep warm for later.
For the Crema
In a small bowl, mix sour cream and the lime juice. - ½ cup Sour Cream - 1 Lime
For The Tomato Sauce
Start by cutting large and dried ancho chile into strips (seeds removed) and dry roast in a pan. - 1 large Dried Ancho Chile
Dry roast cumin seeds, put into a spice grinder, and grind into a finely-ground consistency. - 2 ½ tbsp Cumin Seeds
Roughly chop onion, jalapeno, green pepper, red pepper, and garlic. - 1 small Onion - 1 Jalapeno - ½ Green Bell Pepper - ½ Red Bell Pepper - 1 clove Garlic
Start heating up a water with the dried ancho chile and bring to a simmer to get the chile soft. - ½ cup Water

Preheat vegetable oil in a large saute pan and add chopped vegetables. Saute over medium-high heat until there’s some nice color on them. Then add garlic and saute for another minute, be careful not to burn the garlic. - 1 ½ tbsp Vegetable Oil

Into the same pan, add chipotle chile and a couple tbsp of the adobo sauce. Then add freshly ground cumin and saute. Add fire roasted crushed tomatoes. - 1 Chipotle Adobo Sauce (from can) and a few of the sauce - 14 ounce can Fire Roasted Crushed Tomatoes - 1 tbsp Cumin Seeds

Add the water and dried ancho chile into the saute pan. Cook for an additional 10 minutes, taste for seasoning and add Kosher salt and pepper as needed. Then dump the whole thing into a blender and blend on high speed until chunky smooth. Set aside and keep warm while you prepare the other elements. - Kosher Salt - Freshly Ground Pepper
For the Beans

Saute drained beans with olive oil over medium-high heat. Then season with Kosher salt, freshly ground pepper, the zest of one lime, and the juice of half a lime. Saute for another 30 seconds and cover to keep warm. - can of Black Beans - Kosher Salt - Freshly Ground Pepper - 1 Lime - 1 ½ tbsp Olive Oil
For The Huevos Rancheros
In vegetable oil, fry corn tortillas enough to be crisp but still flexible, then drain on paper towels. - For the Corn Tortillas - ¼ tbsp Vegetable Oil
Cook eggs sunny side up in a hot non-stick pan and baste the whites with the hot oil to ensure nice crispy edges and fully cooked egg whites. - 2 Eggs

On serving plate, place corn tortillas and add sauce, then beans, then fried egg. Top with extra sauce and crema as desired. From here you can top with sliced avocado, chopped onion, cilantro, or anything you want. - For the Corn Tortillas - For the Fancy Tomato Sauce - For the Beans - Eggs - For the Crema - Avocado - Onion - Cilantro
Enjoy!
